D/ D N HONORI-VS P F AVG ; R/ VICTORI-A AVGGG ; D/ D N THEODO-SIVS P F AVG ; R/ VIRTVS RO-MANORVM ; D/ D N TH[EODO-SIVS P F AVG] ; R/ [VIRTVS RO-MANORVM] ; D/ [____]VS P F A[VG] ; R/ VIRT[VS RO-MANORVM] ; D/ D N GRATIA-NVS P F AVG ; R/ VRBS ROMA ; D/ D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG ; D/ [D N V]ALENTINI[-

A hoard of 14 late roman coins: 13 silver siliqua, 1 gold solidus and a silver ingot, probably deposited between c.AD 400 - c. 430 (tpq of coins AD 395 to 402). Description: Coin 1: A gold solidus of Honorius (r. 393-423). VICTORIA AVGGG reverse, emperor standing right, holding a standard and Victory-on-globe with his foot on a fallen captive. Minted at Milan, between 395-402. (Reece Period 21).…
